item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":3,"rationale":"The President presently determines and modifies the statutory moratorium, allowing specified Mexican-domiciled carriers to seek operating authority while retaining the domestic-service restriction; the legal change occurs on the memorandum's date.","evidence":"These modifications shall be effective on the date of this memorandum."},{"segment_id":"2","code":3,"rationale":"The President makes the statutory determination that expedited action is required, thereby presently exercising the determination authority under 49 U.S.C. 13902(c)(5).","evidence":"I hereby determine that expeditious action is required"},{"segment_id":"3","code":1,"rationale":"The President authorizes the Department of Transportation to process covered applications immediately but does not dictate whether any application must be granted or denied.","evidence":"the Department of Transportation is authorized to act on applications"},{"segment_id":"4","code":1,"rationale":"The Department must coordinate with other federal entities during application review; the remainder states that carriers remain governed by existing generally applicable laws rather than creating a new legal consequence.","evidence":"the Department shall continue to work closely with the Department of Justice"}]}
